newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lower Saxon employers, unions agree job security.
newsitem.headline: Lower Saxon employers, unions agree job security.

text.p: Employers and the worker's union IG Metall in the German state of Lower Saxony, reached agreement on Tuesday on a new job security contract, the local branch of IG Metall said.
Local IG Metall head Juergen Peters said after negotiations in Hanover that the working week could now be reduced from 35 to 29 hours without an accompanying wage compensation agreement.
The agreement would run to the end of 1997.
